FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standardllnltitution on 7 February 1980, after the draft finalized by the Pelc Control Sectional Committee had been approved by the Agricultural and Food Products Division Council and the Chemical Division CouDcil. 0.2 Lindane granules are used for control of insect peltl of medical. veterinary and agricultural importance.

0.3 Lindane granules are generally manufactured to contain 6 percent ( m/til ) of lindane.
0.4 In the preparation of this standard due consideration hal been given to the provisions of the Insecticides Act. 1968 and the R.ule. framed thereunder. However, this standard is lubject to the reltrictions imposed under these, wherever applicable.
0.5 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requiremeDt of tbis standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, Ihall be rounded off in accordance with IS: 2�1960�. The number of lilDificant places retained in the rounded off value should be the lame as that of the specified value in this standard.
